name: dubbo-go
readme_excerpt: Apache Dubbo for Golang English | 中文 Apache Dubbo-go is a high-performance RPC and microservice framework compatible with other Dubbo language implementations. It leverages Golang's concurrency features to provide efficient service governance, including service discovery, load balancing, and traffic management.
